title: Sidewalk Art Exhibit with Framed Paintings, 1956 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: An outdoor sidewalk art display featuring framed oil landscape, floral, and architectural paintings mounted on display stands along a city street. A small wooden painter's palette hangs prominently among the frames. Parked mid-century automobiles and a multi-story city building stand in the background. The upper margin is stamped 'JUN • 56', showcasing a typical 1950s open-air neighborhood art fair such as the Greenwich Village Outdoor Art Show.
